# BULLMONK Intelligence

> International Macroeconomic Intelligence, Sovereign Bond Flows, and Geopolitical Strategy

## Overview
BULLMONK is an international financial intelligence publication delivering deep, human-researched investigative reporting across central banking policies, currency clearing corridors, semiconductor supply chains, and sovereign energy markets.

## Core Newsroom Sections
- [Home Wire](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/): Real-time financial dispatches and macroeconomic analyses.
- [Financial Tools](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/#tools): Quantitative financial tools including Sovereign Real Yield Calculator, Foreign Exchange Reserve Ratio, and Geopolitical Supply Chain Risk Matrix.
- [About & Bureaus](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/#about): Editorial leadership and international bureau directory across New York, London, Frankfurt, Bengaluru, Toronto, and Sydney.

## Editorial Policies & Compliance
- [Editorial Standards & Sourcing](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/#editorial): 72-hour trading moratorium and mandatory two-source verification.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/#privacy): GDPR, CCPA, and Google AdSense disclosures.
- [Financial Disclaimer](https://www.govtnaukri4u.com/#disclaimer): YMYL financial disclaimer and SEC/FINRA/FCA/SEBI notices.
